snippet.title: Polish Pierogi - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🥟 Ready to serve up some delicious Polish classics?

Polish Pierogi is out now with a FREE demo!
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4719120/Polish_Pierogi/

👨‍🍳 Run your own pierogi restaurant! Prepare traditional Polish dumplings, serve hungry customers, upgrade your kitchen, and keep everyone coming back for more. Can you handle the rush? 🍽️

🎮 Play the demo for free and wishlist the full game!
